note: ADD63 (real, 2026-09-22): ONE machine, no phases, but five numbered commands that each CHANGE something (install gnupg, fetch the key, write the repo file, refresh apt). The operator: 'a long list of commands without doing one at a time'. Old rule saw nothing; §17.1165 flags it on the change count.
text:
## 👉 Do this next
📍 On: the Proxmox host shell (root@pve)

**Run this now:**
```bash
pct exec 101 -- ls /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ /etc/apt/keyrings/
```
then tell me what it shows.

## Steps
1. Run the command above.
2. Install gnupg:
```bash
pct exec 101 -- apt-get install -y gnupg
```
3. Create the keyring directory and download the signing key:
```bash
pct exec 101 -- mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
pct exec 101 -- curl -fsSL https://repo.jellyfin.org/jellyfin_team.gpg.key | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/jellyfin.gpg
```
4. Create the repository file:
```bash
pct exec 101 -- bash -c 'echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/jellyfin.gpg] https://repo.jellyfin.org/debian bookworm main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/jellyfin.list'
```
5. Refresh apt:
```bash
pct exec 101 -- apt-get update
```
